483-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least X life this turn.
6495-6972-7237.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Voracious Wurm.
When Voracious Wurm dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7237.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-5468-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5468-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3417-6831.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible after it enters.
You have a way to deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger after it enters.
3417-6831.description:
Cast Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger by paying its mana cost.
Give Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible.
Deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing double that much damage to itself due to Neriv.
Repeat step 4 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the final Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to any target.
3417-6831.notes: If the source that is dealing damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger is repeatable (such as Pyrohemia), you can deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger again and redirect the damage elsewhere. This combo can be performed using either Ill-Tempered Loner or Howlpack Avenger.

985-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

301-5663-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

933-2103-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Conjurer's Closet.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

423-1437-3257-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3257-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-3257-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to the landfall card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

560-4550-6798-7256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-6798-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Warhost's Frenzy triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Repeat from step 2

338-567-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-567-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2866-4211-4986-5147.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

5256-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5256-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat from step 3.

1793-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Cryptic Trilobite from your library.
Repeat.

618-3580-5686.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2634-4668-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-4668-5148.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

224-1359-1683-3478.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-1359-1683-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Dimir Aqueduct on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-3311-6235.notablePrerequisites:
Snake Umbra attached to Agate Instigator.
You have a way to draw a card.
1339-3311-6235.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Agate Instigator, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

880-4488-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4488-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1238-2351-4452-5231-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

872-2979-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Scaled Herbalist exiled by Patchwork Crawler.
872-2979-4543.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Scaled Herbalist's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Patchwork Crawler.
Repeat.

1462-3729.description:
Cast Ondu Spiritdancer by paying {4}{W}.
When Ondu Spiritdancer enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Ondu Spiritdancer triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 2 using the Ondu Spiritdancer token.

2034-2138-5003.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
2034-2138-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazotep Reaver, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazotep Reaver dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Lazotep Reaver from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Lazotep Reaver enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2-1170-1306-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Ancestral Statue.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Ancestral Statue.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1082-1315-2232-2766.notablePrerequisites:
A Swamp and a Forest on the battlefield.
At least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
1082-1315-2232-2766.description:
Activate the Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Zuran Orb twice by sacrificing those two lands, gaining 4 life.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
Molderhulk enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Dual Nature, and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a Molderhulk token.
The Molderhulk token and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Molderhulk leaves the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature and exiling all Molderhulk tokens.
Resolve the token Molderhulk trigger, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything.
Repeat.

396-862-2232.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary, creating a 2/2 Unicron creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2762-4853-5116.notablePrerequisites: Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters.
2762-4853-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any one color.
Activate Thopter Squadron first ability by paying {1} and removing +1/+1 counter, creating a 1/1 Thopter token.
Activate Thopter Squadron second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

876-1475-2034.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Lightning Greaves attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
876-1475-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightning Greaves attached, adding {C}{C}.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

618-2438-4681.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3554-4377-4635.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Demonic Collusion by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Demonic Collusion and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

473-4067.description:
Activate Archivist by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Archivist.
Repeat.
